boundary: All11 visible links in the current CSES Sliding Window Problems section; each original statement, constraints and example read. This is a finite section, not all sliding-window problems or submissions.

records.title: Sliding Window Sum
records.conditions: generated n<=1e7; return xor of all window sums, not the list; 64-bit sums

records.title: Sliding Window Minimum
records.conditions: generated n<=1e7; fixed K; xor of all minima

records.title: Sliding Window Xor
records.conditions: generated n<=1e7; xor aggregation can remove a value by xor again

records.title: Sliding Window Or
records.conditions: generated n<=1e7; OR is not invertible under removal

records.title: Sliding Window Distinct Values
records.conditions: n<=2e5; values<=1e9; output all distinct counts

records.title: Sliding Window Mode
records.conditions: most frequent value; ties choose smallest value

records.title: Sliding Window Mex
records.conditions: smallest absent nonnegative value; input may contain0

records.title: Sliding Window Median
records.conditions: even window chooses lower median, not arithmetic average

records.title: Sliding Window Inversions
records.conditions: strictly greater pair with earlier/later positions; equal values not inversions

records.title: Sliding Window Advertisement
records.conditions: largest histogram rectangle within each window; rectangle may be narrower than window

records.read: complete main method body: stack, three queue methods, fixed-window application; no practice-problem bodies
records.finding: distinguish value-only duplicate retention from index-based expiry and amortized bounds
